## ACCEPT: PR objectui#12199 (head `867148d389`) · `domain:ui` seat 1 · `session_016djJF12Qt14ejKR5Vjt4sK` · 2026-10-12T07:28Z

Reviewed against GitHub and the diff, not the report (`os-dev-report` `6119705632`). Claim `6119206175`.

### Verdict

- **Shape:**
  - Draft on `main` (base `26b0bd2`). The first line is `Fixes #12188`, and `Clause-②: no` sits at a line start.
  - Assignee `os-steve`. No model identifier in the commits or the body.
- **Scope:** 4 files, +444/−10. The runtime change is `packages/plugin-list/src/ObjectGallery.tsx` alone (+49/−10); the rest is two pins and the changeset. `check-governed-merges --pr objectstack-ai/objectui#12199`: NOT governed.
- **The fix follows the ruling, with no second lookup-to-label path:**
  - **The heading content.** A title field of the `isExpandableFieldType` family (`lookup`, `master_detail`, `tree`, `user`; `@object-ui/core`, already exported) renders through `getCellRenderer(resolveCellRendererType(buildEnrichedField(titleField)))`. That is the same path `renderFields` and the grid already use.
  - **The title text.** The tooltip, the icon tile and the placeholder seed read `getRecordDisplayName(objectDef, item, { titleField })`. That is the ADR-0079 resolver this function already fell back to, and its `titleField` option already exists at `26b0bd2` (`packages/core/src/utils/record-title.ts`).
  - **Every other title is plain text.** That covers a non-reference title, an empty value, or no definition to type the field, so a plain text heading is byte-identical.
- **One check of my own, on the new click surface.** A lookup title now renders `LookupCellRenderer`. When the host publishes `recordHref`, that renderer draws an anchor inside a card whose `onClick` navigates to the card's own record. The anchor's own handler calls `e.stopPropagation()` (`ReferencedRecordLink` in `@object-ui/fields`), so following the reference does not also open the card. Nothing to add.
- **A premise correction, accepted:** the Members tab's title column is `sys_member.user_id`, declared as a `lookup` to `sys_user`, not a `user`-type field. Both value shapes are pinned. The `$expand`-ed record and the bare id (resolved by the cell's own fetch, `findOne('sys_user', …)`) both draw the name.
- **The pins carry weight:**
  - `ObjectGallery.lookupTitle-12188` has 6 cases: 5 legs plus a plain-text control. They are red on the base blob (5 of 6) and green on the head. A partial ablation (the cell half off) reddens only the id-shape leg.
  - `RelatedList.mobileLookupTitle-12188` (test-only, so no `plugin-detail` bump) pins what `RelatedList` hands the card at 375 px. The two pins meet at the node shape, because `plugin-detail` cannot depend on `plugin-list`.
- **A behaviour change, declared:** a title that is blank after trimming, or a list of values, now falls back to the record's display name. It used to print as-is. This is in the changeset and the PR.
- **The H5 list is in the PR body, one verdict per layout:**
  - the gallery card title: fixed here;
  - the gallery group header: reported;
  - the kanban card title: reported;
  - `RelatedList` `type: 'list'`: never reached;
  - `ObjectGrid`'s phone card: names an expanded record, but prints an unexpanded id raw.
- **Changeset:** `@object-ui/plugin-list` `patch`. No export, prop or type member changes.
- **Gates on this head, read at this record:** 25 success, 3 skipped by design, 14 in progress, 0 failure. The seat enqueues only once all of them read `success`.

### Out-of-scope findings (carrier: this record; not filed)

The dev reproduced two members of one family: a card-shaped layout drawing a reference value raw. Neither has a `reach:` the filing gate accepts. Both were reproduced at component level on the public node, not in a running app, and `git grep` finds no in-tree producer authoring either shape (`cardTitle` / `titleField` naming a lookup, or gallery `grouping` by one).

1. **Kanban card title.** `ObjectKanban`'s `effectiveData` sets `title` to `item[explicitTitleField]` raw, and `KanbanImpl` renders `card.title` as a child. On a board whose `cardTitle` names an `$expand`-ed lookup, React throws "Objects are not valid as a React child", and the board renders empty. This is worse than this card's symptom. Once one real board that authors this is named, it qualifies as a card on its own.
2. **Gallery group header.** `groupedItems` labels the header with `String(val)`, so grouping by an expanded lookup draws `[object Object]`.

Also noted in the PR's Acceptance notes, with no carrier: a non-reference title type prints its stored value where the grid formats it, and nothing registers a `data-list` renderer.

**Landing:** ready and auto-merge through the merge queue once every check on `867148d` is `success` or skipped by design. Acceptance item 1, the zh-CN screenshot of the Members tab at 375 px on staging, follows once cloud's objectui pin carries this merge.
